tiers.names_own: UNINFORMATIVE -- assigned entities are the answer options; ~1.0 under both modes; reported only so its symmetry is visible
tiers.tier2_clause: HEADLINE. Standing claim and the speaker's own entity in the same clause, no other candidate intervening
tiers.tier2_lenient: same, but with the guard off AND the coarser conjunction-only segmentation. The gap to tier2_clause is the whole correction; guard_rejections isolates the guard's share of it, the remainder being finer segmentation
tiers.tier2_proximity: legacy: standing within 120 chars of the entity, no clause scoping at all
tiers.exclusion_disclosure: standing clause names every candidate except the speaker's own -- discloses by elimination
tiers.tier3_explicit: assignment verb binding speaker to the entity
tiers.other_agent_assignment: another agent bound to an entity by an assignment predicate -- a real leak
tiers.other_agent_attribution: NOT A LEAK. Any claim about an entity credited to a named agent; this is testimony relay, i.e. the task itself
tiers.frozen_verifier_round1: raw rows -- one generation replayed across arms, so a single wording is counted several times
tiers.frozen_verifier_round1_distinct_wordings: deduplicated on the wording; this is the rate per distinct verifier message and the one to quote
tiers.bound: all rates are lower bounds; paraphrase is not matched
